facts: Neighbours: Brazil, Paraguay, Argentina, Chile and Peru
One-third of the country is in the Andes
worth_knowing: Andean region in the west, with the high Altiplano plateau, and tropical lowlands in the east and north. With Paraguay it is one of two landlocked countries in the Americas.
